rules.description: Secondary and auxiliary tray modules must not mutate the primary keyboard through the configured tray-engine receiver spellings. Generic engine and secondary-target receivers remain allowed; dynamic object aliases are not inferred.

calls.message: Secondary-device modules must not mutate the primary keyboard through tray.engine.kb.
Secondary-device modules must not mutate the primary keyboard through tray.engine.

rules.description: Hardware observation modules must not directly mutate desired config or forced-off policy.

assignments.message: Hardware observation modules must not directly mutate desired config or forced-off policy; use the owning policy or pipeline boundary.

rules.description: Core modules must stay independent from tray and GUI layers.

patterns.message: Core modules must not import tray or gui modules.

rules.description: Production code must import backend policy from canonical leaf modules, not historical facades or the policies package root.

imports.message: Historical keyrgb.core.backends.policy is removed; import the owning leaf under keyrgb.core.backends.policies.

patterns.message: Import the exact backend policy leaf module; do not import the policies package root.
Import the exact backend policy leaf module; do not import the policies package root.

rules.description: Diagnostics collection must not import or construct the live mutable Config object.

imports.message: Diagnostics must not import the live Config module; load settings through load_config_settings() into a readonly view.
Diagnostics must not import live Config; load settings through load_config_settings() into a readonly view.

rules.description: GUI modules should not couple directly to tray runtime modules.

patterns.message: GUI modules must not import tray runtime modules.

rules.description: GUI modules must not spawn worker threads directly. Blocking hardware and OS work goes through keyrgb.gui.utils.tk_async.

patterns.message: GUI modules must not start Thread(target=...) directly; use TkAsyncCoordinator, submit_gui_work, or run_in_thread.

rules.description: Tray UI should not probe backends directly; selection belongs in app or controller layers.

patterns.message: Tray UI should not import backend selection directly.

rules.description: Public GUI window modules should not import backend selection directly.

imports.message: GUI window modules should not import backend selection directly; move selection into bootstrap or target adapters.
GUI window modules should not import secondary-device route registries directly; resolve routes in bootstrap or adapters.

rules.description: Per-key GUI helpers should not import backend selection directly.

imports.message: Per-key GUI helpers should not import backend selection directly; expose backend and device access through bootstrap or injected helpers.

rules.description: Tray UI should not import core profile storage directly.

imports.message: Tray UI should not import core profile storage directly; use callbacks, app services, or controller adapters.

rules.description: Tray UI should not call or mutate private tray runtime hooks directly.

attributes.name: _update_menu
attributes.message: Tray UI should not call private tray menu refresh hooks directly; route through callbacks or app services.

attributes.name: _update_icon
attributes.message: Tray UI should not call private tray icon refresh hooks directly; route through callbacks or app services.

attributes.name: _start_current_effect
attributes.message: Tray UI should not start private tray effect hooks directly; delegate through effect-selection or controller adapters.

attributes.name: _system_power_last_ok
attributes.message: Tray UI should not mutate private tray runtime state directly; use an app-owned state or service boundary.

rules.description: Tray menu construction must render tray-owned presentation snapshots. It must not query OS power sysfs, probe secondary-route availability, or acquire hardware.

imports.message: Tray UI must not query OS power status; read tray.system_power_status via view_snapshots.
Tray UI must not probe secondary-route availability; read tray.effective_secondary_routes via view_snapshots.

attributes.name: _ensure_device_available
attributes.message: Tray UI must not acquire hardware through engine._ensure_device_available(); read engine.device_available.

calls.message: Tray UI must not call get_status(); read the tray-owned system_power_status snapshot.
Tray UI must not call iter_effective_secondary_routes(); read the tray-owned effective_secondary_routes snapshot.
Tray UI must not probe backends; render tray.backend_probe and engine.device_available.

rules.description: Automatic AC/DC, idle, scheduler, and hardware-poller paths must not rebuild the live tray menu; rebuilding an open AppIndicator/SNI menu can crash KDE plasmashell.

attributes.name: _update_menu
attributes.message: Automatic power/idle/hardware paths must not call _update_menu(); pass refresh_menu=False on UI refresh.

patterns.message: Automatic power/idle/hardware paths must not rebuild the live tray menu; pass refresh_menu=False.

rules.description: The removed legacy effects ite_backend shim must stay unused.
Reactive loops receive an explicit dependency facade; they must not inject APIs through module globals or sys.modules.

patterns.message: Reactive code must not inject dependencies through globals().update(); pass a ReactiveApiFacade.
Reactive code must not recover an API from sys.modules; pass a ReactiveApiFacade.

rules.description: Tray/effect primary-keyboard lighting writes stay in serialized, lock-protected output-owner boundaries.

calls.message: Tray/effect primary-keyboard lighting writes must stay in an approved output-owner file.
calls.lock_message: Tray/effect primary-keyboard lighting writes must be lexically protected by the keyboard lock.

rules.description: Pollers observe; the deck pipeline and approved leaves commit primary engine mutations.

calls.message: Pollers must observe; route primary engine mutations through the deck pipeline or an approved commit leaf.
Pollers must not apply primary brightness directly; route the mutation through the deck pipeline or an approved commit leaf.
Pollers must not stop the primary engine directly; route the mutation through the deck pipeline or an approved commit leaf.

rules.description: Nested in-process runtime locks must follow the canonical acquisition order.

lock_orders.message: Nested runtime lock acquisitions must follow _start_lock -> kb_lock -> _brightness_fade_lock order.

rules.description: Blocking operations must not run while holding the primary keyboard lock.

forbidden_under_locks.message: time.sleep() must not run while holding the primary keyboard lock.
Blocking join(), wait(), and communicate() calls must not run while holding the primary keyboard lock.
subprocess operations must not run while holding the primary keyboard lock.

rules.description: ITE 8258 chassis profile coordination and protocol stay backend-local. Tray, GUI, and unrelated core modules must not import packet layout or the coordinator.

imports.message: Profile coordination stays inside ite8258_perkey_chassis; tray/GUI/other core modules must not import the coordinator.
ITE 8258 chassis packet layout stays inside ite8258_perkey_chassis; do not import protocol from tray, GUI, or unrelated core modules.

rules.description: Tray pollers request icon/menu refresh facades; they must not import or load pystray themselves.

imports.message: Pollers must not import pystray; request refresh through tray UI facades.

patterns.message: Pollers must not load pystray via import_module; request refresh through tray UI facades.

rules.description: Core profile activation accepts explicit hooks and must not resolve private tray methods or import tray packages.

patterns.message: Core profile modules must not import tray; callers inject runtime hooks.
Core profile code must not look up private attributes by name; pass explicit hooks.

rules.description: Hardware-effect payload building must not inspect __code__ or __closure__; builders publish accepted_kwargs.

patterns.message: Hardware-effect builders must not inspect __code__; declare accepted_kwargs on hardware_effect_builder().
Hardware-effect builders must not inspect __closure__; declare accepted_kwargs on hardware_effect_builder().
